fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/PDP/NewTruckPdp.cy.js#PDP - NewTruckPdp [mostPopular] [en] — Tata Yodha 2.0 Page blocks (same session) TC-NTPDP-26: SecondaryNavbar Calculate EMI jumps to the EMI calculator for Tata Yodha 2.0
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NTPDP-26
**Title:** SecondaryNavbar Calculate EMI jumps to the EMI calculator for Tata Yodha 2.0
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Use the SecondaryNavbar “Calculate EMI” jump link on Tata Yodha 2.0 and confirm it takes the user to the on-page EMI calculator, not to a different page.

**Expected Result:**
The EMI calculator (Down Payment, tenure buttons and Monthly EMI) is shown after clicking Calculate EMI.

**Steps:**
1. On the product page with launch lead closed
2. Click Calculate EMI on SecondaryNavbar
3. Verify the EMI calculator is shown
